# 装备与饰品｜v1生成提示词

生成方式：内置 imagegen。图像参考仅用于视觉设计，非原游戏3D模型。

## 母图

Use case: stylized-concept. Roblox survival game replacement asset concept in a coherent simplified LOW-POLY 3D family. Chunky bevels, clearly faceted surfaces, matte materials, 5-8 readable main shapes, restrained wear and restrained technology glow. Neutral warm beige studio background, soft shadows, clean complete isolated object, no environment, no real people, no caption, no labels, no watermark. This is visual game concept art, NOT a functional blueprint. No realistic gore, decay, blood, exposed organs or gun cutaways. Do NOT copy square machine plinths or energy generators from style references. NO base or platform unless intrinsically part of edible bowl; maintain appropriate natural silhouette. Create a FAMILY DESIGN MASTER contact sheet, 4 columns, 4 rows, exactly 16 distinct objects, one object per occupied cell, leave remaining cells blank. All cells use same elevated front-right camera and identical material language. Each object complete, clear separation, generous margins. No three views here; ONE view per object. Keep handgrip/attachment dimensions comparable within families; animals retain squirrel < hyena < bear/deathclaw relative sizes, no forced equal real-world height. Composition cell order is LEFT TO RIGHT, TOP TO BOTTOM. The designs in exact cell order:
1. A matched PAIR of dark grey armored high boots with small inset sole thruster ports and compact ankle plates, no legs, no flames, no standalone platform.
2. Standalone brown leather CHEST VEST with two shoulder straps, thick hand-stitched panels and FOUR copper rivets, open arm holes, no head/limbs/mannequin.
3. Standalone charcoal steel CHEST ARMOR with broad rectangular front plate, two shoulder tabs and dark leather side straps, subtle stamped geometric bird mark, no mannequin or limbs.
4. Standalone compact cobalt-blue powered CHEST AND BACK armor assembly, broad angled ceramic plates, white-grey shoulder tabs, two rear short vents, small central power indicator, open neck/armholes, no helmet or limbs.
5. Standalone gold-coated heavy chest armor with plain graphite inner carrier, broad beveled plates and simple eagle medallion, no ornate filigree, no limbs or mannequin.
6. Standalone grey-white faceted ceramic ballistic CHEST carrier with dark fabric straps and one small cyan status inset, angular shoulder tabs, no crystal or fantasy gem, no limbs.
7. Wearable standalone amber single-piece dust goggles attached to a dark cloth lower-face mask, simple rear elastic strap, open forehead, no human head.
8. Standalone black rubber full-face respirator, TWO round glass eye lenses, TWO identical side filter canisters and rear straps, no head or helmet.
9. A matching PAIR of black high tactical boots, chunky ribbed soles, broad toe caps, three simple lace bands and ankle straps, no legs.
10. Standalone grey-green chitin chest armor, THREE broad overlapping curved shell plates, simple brown shoulder straps, mineral shell texture and two blunt ridges, no limbs.
11. Standalone pale yellow sealed protective HOOD, wide dark transparent face window, TWO small filter ports and thick black neck seal, no head, torso or gloves.
12. Standalone black CHEST armor with two thick shoulder support arches, compact side servo hinges and graphite front ballistic plate, small blue battery at back, no arms/legs.
13. Standalone folded sand-brown hoodless neck scarf/cowl, coarse triangular cloth drape, one simple knot and frayed lower edge, no head or full cape.
14. Standalone charcoal silk tactical neck cowl, layered smooth folded collar, short triangular chest drape and ONE silver clasp, subtle woven sheen, no full cape or body.
15. Standalone teal/navy sealed chest armor, rounded pressure plate, thick dark gasket seams, one compact sonar status inset and two small rear ports, open armholes, no helmet/limbs.
16. Standalone sand-grey composite chest vest with neat cream fur collar and dark inset shoulder webbing, compact rear battery panel, no seasonal ornaments, no mannequin/limbs.
